visual_text: Ask: what will the later stages of dementia bring?
US study: 323 care home residents with advanced dementia, followed for 18 months
Died during the study: about 55 in 100
Figures are for late-stage dementia in US care homes only.
Three questions to ask the care team
What usually happens in the later stages?
What will be done for comfort either way?
Mitchell et al., N Engl J Med 2009
alt_text: Question card on dementia: in a US study of 323 care home residents with advanced dementia over 18 months, about 86 in 100 had an eating problem, 53 in 100 fever, 41 in 100 pneumonia and 55 in 100 died. US care homes only. Three questions to ask the care team: what usually happens, would hospital help, what will be done for comfort.
design_instructions: Single card, four white rows with orange figures (text, not bars), mint panel with three numbered questions. No drawing. Claim C19-24-a.
